source: Jal Jeevan Mission IMIS public reports (Department of Drinking Water and Sanitation): B26 schemes by source, E5 tested sources
caveat: Sources include delivery points and stand posts as the mission counts them. A test above a chemical limit is a water-quality reading, not a forecast, and says nothing about why. The mission reports districts as they were before 2022; each mandal is listed under that district.
